# dmcheck
Deterministic conduct verdicts for live tabletop sessions — CI for running a
game. Eight rules calibrated against 134 hours of professional play and
validated on held-out episodes; ambiguity produces silence, never
accusations. Install: pip install dmcheck. CLI: dmcheck run|watch|craft|
init|explain|lint-charter. init --dm bootstraps a new DM (charter +
session-zero + the nine measured defaults). craft = advisory attention lane:
rates vs the professional envelope, one signal at a time, categorical defect
checks, no score ever. MCP server: io.github.chaoz23/dmcheck. Ask it: "did
the GM leave questions hanging", "watch this session live", "is my line
length in the professional band".
